claims.quote: we apply several known technical modifications to the Transformer architecture, such as interleaving local-global attentions (Beltagy et al., 2020a) and group-query attention (Ainslie et al., 2023).
claims.reason: Authors explicitly label group-query attention a known modification and cite Ainslie et al. 2023, so it is not an ARCH novelty they claim as their own. Although Table 8 (p.5) does compare MHA vs GQA on two 9B instances, that comparison is not coded because the claim is not kept.
